title: Aum! Hek! Wal! Ak! Lub! Mor! Ma!
html_source: My source has it that these are “root-words of speech, according to George Russell’s theories of the origins of language (e.g., ‘Ma’ is associated with thinking). From Pen. 20 c. Classics Annotated Students Edition.

anchor.text: Aum! Hek! Wal! Ak! Lub! Mor! Ma!
